title: 厄勒海峽大橋~Oresund Bridge
focus: 在零阻水的環境約束下，以整跨預製與浮吊安裝完成公路鐵路雙層斜張橋~Building a double-deck road–rail cable-stayed crossing by full-span prefabrication and floating-crane erection under a zero-blocking constraint
summary: 厄勒海峽大橋是連接丹麥與瑞典固定通道的橋梁段，全長約 7,845 公尺，主跨 490 公尺的斜張高橋與兩側 140 公尺跨的引橋都採用上層公路、下層鐵路的鋼—混凝土複合桁架。本課從海峽零阻水要求、雙層桁架與豎琴式斜索的荷載路徑出發，拆解石灰岩上的預鑄沉箱、204 公尺混凝土橋塔、Svanen 浮吊整跨吊裝與主跨合龍，再談鐵路制動力、船撞風險、疲勞防蝕與鋼軌伸縮調節器的交接。~The Øresund Bridge is the bridge section of the fixed link between Denmark and Sweden: about 7,845 m long, with a cable-stayed high bridge of 490 m main span and approach viaducts of 140 m spans, all built as steel–concrete composite trusses carrying a motorway above and a railway below. The course starts from the strait's zero-blocking requirement and the load path through double-deck trusses and harp stays, then covers precast caissons on limestone, the 204 m concrete pylons, full-span lifts by the floating crane Svanen and main-span closure, ending with rail braking, ship-impact risk, fatigue and corrosion, and the handover of rail expansion devices.

units.anchor: 橋墩阻水斷面~Pier blockage cross-section
units.title: 零阻水要求與海峽環境~The zero-blocking requirement
units.mechanism: 厄勒海峽是北海鹹水流入波羅的海的主要通道之一，任何固定通道若減少水流，就可能改變波羅的海的鹽度與溶氧。因此丹麥與瑞典要求通道對水流、鹽分與氧氣交換的淨影響為零：設計者先修整橋墩、沉箱與人工島形狀，把計算阻水率由約 2.3% 降到約 0.5%，剩下的部分以補償性浚挖加深海床抵銷。這個要求直接影響結構：橋墩數量與尺寸、沉箱外形、引橋跨徑都要在阻水與造價之間取捨，橋梁設計成為海洋環境工程的一部分。~The Øresund is one of the main routes by which North Sea salt water enters the Baltic, so a fixed link that reduced flow could change Baltic salinity and oxygen. Denmark and Sweden therefore required zero net effect on flow, salt and oxygen exchange: designers first trimmed piers, caissons and the artificial island, cutting calculated blocking from about 2.3% to about 0.5%, and offset the rest by compensation dredging that deepened the seabed. The rule shaped the structure directly: number and size of piers, caisson outlines and approach span lengths were traded between blocking and cost, making bridge design part of marine environmental engineering.
units.model: 設某檢核斷面過水面積 A = 60,000 m²，殘餘阻水 0.5% 相當於損失 ΔA = 0.005×60,000 = 300 m²；若在 3,000 m 寬的補償區把海床平均加深 0.10 m，即可補回 300 m²，補償區長 2,000 m 時浚挖量約 0.10×3,000×2,000 = 600,000 m³。斷面與尺寸為教學假設；全工程浚挖約 750 萬 m³，包含隧道溝槽與造島。~Take a check section with a flow area A = 60,000 m²; residual blocking of 0.5% loses ΔA = 0.005×60,000 = 300 m². Deepening a 3,000 m wide compensation zone by an average 0.10 m restores 300 m², and over 2,000 m of length that is about 0.10×3,000×2,000 = 600,000 m³ of dredging. Section and sizes are teaching assumptions; the whole project dredged about 7.5 million m³, including the tunnel trench and reclamation.
units.verify: 以水理數值模型與物理模型比較建設前後的流量、鹽度與水位差，計算每個構造物的阻水貢獻；施工中監測浚挖溢散的懸浮物，完工後以多音束測深確認補償區的實際斷面，並以長期海流觀測驗證零阻水目標。~Compare flow, salinity and water-level differences before and after construction with numerical and physical hydraulic models, computing the blocking contribution of each structure; during works monitor suspended sediment spill from dredging, after completion confirm the compensation zone by multibeam survey, and verify the zero-blocking goal by long-term current measurements.
units.failure: 若施工中臨時平台、圍堰或堆置物超出計畫，阻水在施工期就超過允許值；補償浚挖若不足或日後淤積回填，長期淨阻水不為零，可能引起環境責任與追加浚挖，甚至限制日後增建或補強的空間。~Temporary platforms, cofferdams or stockpiles beyond plan can exceed the allowed blocking during construction; insufficient compensation dredging or later siltation leaves a net long-term blockage, triggering environmental liability, extra dredging and even limiting future additions or strengthening.
units.misconception: 橋墩只佔海峽很小的面積，對水流沒有可量測的影響。~Piers occupy so little of a strait that they have no measurable effect on flow.
units.practice: 環境要求應轉成結構設計的量化指標（每座墩的阻水當量、施工期臨時阻水上限），納入設計審查與施工許可；任何改變墩形或增加臨時構造物的變更，都須重新計算阻水並經環境主管機關同意。~Environmental requirements should become quantified design criteria, such as the blocking equivalent of each pier and a temporary blocking limit during works, included in design review and permits; any change to pier shape or added temporary works needs a recalculated blocking figure and environmental-authority approval.

units.anchor: 雙層鋼桁與豎琴式斜索~Double-deck truss and harp stays
units.title: 公路鐵路雙層桁架斜張主橋~Double-deck road–rail cable-stayed bridge
units.mechanism: 厄勒海峽大橋的上部結構是鋼—混凝土複合桁架：上層混凝土橋面板承載四線道公路並作為桁架上弦的一部分，下層桁架內承載雙軌鐵路。高橋為主跨 490 公尺、邊跨 160 與 141 公尺的斜張橋，斜索以豎琴式排列，在桁架上每 20 公尺錨碇一處、在塔上每 12 公尺一處，邊跨另設橋墩限制主跨撓度。雙層桁架提供很大的梁深，使鐵路所需的勁度與撓度限制容易達成；豎琴式斜索角度一致，視覺整齊，但對塔的彎矩較扇形配置敏感，因此邊跨墩的布置很重要。~The superstructure is a steel–concrete composite truss: the upper concrete deck carries a four-lane motorway and acts as part of the top chord, and the lower deck inside the truss carries a double-track railway. The high bridge is cable-stayed with a 490 m main span and 160 m and 141 m side spans; its stays form a harp, anchored every 20 m on the truss and every 12 m on the pylons, with side-span piers limiting main-span deflection. The deep double-deck truss makes the stiffness and deflection limits needed for rail easy to meet; harp stays share one angle and look orderly, but make the pylons more sensitive to bending than a fan, so the side-span piers matter.
units.model: 豎琴式斜索的角度由錨距決定：tanθ = 12/20 = 0.6，θ ≈ 31.0°，sinθ ≈ 0.514。若每個索面承受 w = 200 kN/m，每根索支撐 20 m，索力 T = w·s/sinθ = 200×20/0.514 ≈ 7,775 kN；73 股鋼絞線的破斷力約 18,660 kN，利用率約 42%。w 為教學假設。~The harp angle follows from the anchor spacings: tanθ = 12/20 = 0.6, θ ≈ 31.0° and sinθ ≈ 0.514. If each cable plane carries w = 200 kN/m and each stay supports 20 m, the stay force is T = w·s/sinθ = 200×20/0.514 ≈ 7,775 kN; a 73-strand stay breaks at about 18,660 kN, a utilisation of about 42%. w is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 以全橋模型比較公路與鐵路荷載的不同排列（雙軌列車交會、單側公路滿載）下的桁架弦桿力、斜索力與撓度；鐵路的撓度、扭轉與端部轉角須逐項對照鐵路規範的限值，並在完工時以列車試驗量測驗證。~Compare chord forces, stay forces and deflections for combinations of road and rail loading, such as two trains passing and one carriageway fully loaded, in a whole-bridge model; check rail deflection, twist and end-rotation limits item by item against railway criteria and verify them by train tests at completion.
units.failure: 若只以公路荷載設計而低估列車的集中載重與動力放大，桁架節點與鐵路縱梁的疲勞會提早出現；豎琴式斜索若邊跨墩配置不足，塔身彎矩與主跨撓度超過鐵路允許值，列車必須限速。~Designing for road load alone while underestimating concentrated train loads and dynamic amplification brings early fatigue at truss joints and rail stringers; with too few side-span piers, a harp arrangement lets pylon bending and main-span deflection exceed rail limits, forcing speed restrictions.
units.misconception: 鐵路與公路共用一座橋時，只要把兩種荷載相加就完成設計。~When rail and road share a bridge, simply adding the two loads completes the design.
units.practice: 設計基準應把鐵路的撓度、扭轉、加速度與端轉角限值列為與強度同等的控制條件，並由鐵路主管機關參與審查；斜索錨距與邊跨墩配置在初步設計就以勁度需求決定，而不是只看外觀。~The design basis should make rail deflection, twist, acceleration and end-rotation limits governing criteria equal to strength, with the railway authority in the review; stay spacing and side-span piers should be set by stiffness needs at preliminary design, not by appearance alone.

units.anchor: 石灰岩上的預鑄沉箱~Precast caissons on limestone
units.title: 預鑄沉箱基礎與定位~Precast caisson foundations and placement
units.mechanism: 橋塔與邊跨墩的基礎是坐落在海平面下約 14 至 17 公尺堅硬石灰岩上的預鑄混凝土沉箱，引橋墩也以類似的大型預鑄件施工。沉箱在岸上或乾塢中製作，以浮吊或浮運移到現場，下放到事先浚挖整平的基床上，再以灌漿填滿底部空隙，讓荷載均勻傳到岩盤。這種作法把大部分混凝土工作移到陸上，減少海上作業時間，但對基床平整度、下放定位與底部灌漿品質要求很高，因為坐落後幾乎無法再調整。~The pylon and side-span pier foundations are precast concrete caissons seated on hard limestone about 14 to 17 m below sea level, and approach piers used similar large precast units. Caissons are cast on shore or in dry dock, moved by floating crane or towing, lowered onto a pre-dredged and levelled bed, and grouted underneath to fill voids so load spreads evenly into the rock. Most concrete work moves ashore and time at sea is reduced, but bed flatness, placing accuracy and underbase grouting become critical because a seated caisson can hardly be adjusted afterwards.
units.model: 沉箱底面若有 1 mm/m（1:1,000）的傾斜，從沉箱底到墩頂共 65 m 時，墩頂水平偏差 = 0.001×65 = 0.065 m = 65 mm，已接近支承與梁段對接可容許的量級。若傾斜減為 0.3 mm/m，偏差降到約 20 mm。高度與允差為教學假設。~A base tilt of 1 mm/m (1:1,000) over 65 m from caisson base to pier top gives a horizontal offset of 0.001×65 = 0.065 m = 65 mm at the pier head, close to what bearings and girder fit-up can tolerate. Reducing the tilt to 0.3 mm/m cuts it to about 20 mm. Height and tolerance are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 下放前以多音束測深與潛水檢查確認基床高程與平整度，下放時以 GNSS 與傾斜儀即時監控位置與傾角；灌漿時記錄灌入量與壓力，與計算的空隙體積比較，完成後檢查溢漿口並量測沉箱頂高程與傾斜，合格後才安裝墩身。~Before lowering confirm bed level and flatness by multibeam survey and divers; during lowering monitor position and tilt by GNSS and inclinometers in real time; during grouting record volume and pressure against the calculated void volume, then check vents and measure caisson-top level and tilt, installing the pier shaft only after acceptance.
units.failure: 基床上殘留軟泥或石塊時，沉箱局部支承、受力集中，日後產生傾斜與不均勻沉陷；底部灌漿不完整讓空隙被海流掏刷，長期下來支承面積減少，墩頂偏位逐年增加。~Soft mud or boulders left on the bed give point support and stress concentrations, leading to tilt and differential settlement; incomplete underbase grout leaves voids that currents scour, shrinking the bearing area and increasing pier-top offset year by year.
units.misconception: 預鑄沉箱又重又大，放到海床上自然就會穩固。~A precast caisson is so heavy that it becomes stable simply by being set on the seabed.
units.practice: 沉箱安裝程序應把基床驗收、下放定位、灌漿與坐落後量測列為依序的停留點，每一步有書面允差與簽認；灌漿配比與溢漿判定標準須事先試驗，並保留潛水檢查影像。~The caisson procedure should make bed acceptance, positioning, grouting and post-seating survey sequential hold points, each with written tolerances and sign-off; grout mixes and vent criteria are trialled in advance and diver inspection videos kept.

units.anchor: 混凝土橋塔與錨箱~Concrete pylons and anchor boxes
units.title: 204 公尺混凝土橋塔與斜索~The 204 m pylons and their stays
units.mechanism: 兩座混凝土橋塔高約 204 公尺，是唯一沒有在陸上預製的主要構件：以自升式模板每次澆置 4 公尺，每節約 7 至 10 天，塔柱下方 17 公尺為實心，以上為中空五邊形斷面，每支塔柱約用 4,335 立方公尺混凝土與 800 公噸鋼筋。斜索錨碇在預埋於塔柱內的鋼錨箱上，把集中的索力分散到混凝土。全橋共 160 根斜索，每根 68 至 73 股、每股 7 根直徑 5 mm 鍍鋅塗蠟鋼線並有塑膠套管，斜索總重約 2,150 公噸。~The two concrete pylons, about 204 m tall, were the only major components not prefabricated on land: self-climbing forms cast 4 m lifts every 7 to 10 days, the legs are solid for the lowest 17 m and hollow pentagons above, and each leg used about 4,335 m³ of concrete and 800 t of reinforcement. Stays anchor in steel anchor boxes cast into the legs, spreading concentrated stay forces into the concrete. The bridge has 160 stays, each of 68 to 73 strands made of seven 5 mm galvanised, waxed wires in plastic sheathing, with about 2,150 t of cable in total.
units.model: 單股 7 根 5 mm 鋼線面積 = 7×π×2.5² ≈ 137.4 mm²；以 f_pu = 1,860 MPa 計，73 股破斷力 ≈ 73×137.4×1,860 ≈ 18,660 kN，約 1,900 公噸，與公開的每索約 2,000 公噸同量級。塔柱 204 m ÷ 4 m ≈ 51 次澆置，每次 7 至 10 天，約需 357 至 510 天。f_pu 為教學假設。~One strand of seven 5 mm wires has 7×π×2.5² ≈ 137.4 mm²; with f_pu = 1,860 MPa, 73 strands break at about 73×137.4×1,860 ≈ 18,660 kN, about 1,900 t, consistent in magnitude with the published figure of about 2,000 t per cable. A 204 m leg needs 204 ÷ 4 ≈ 51 lifts at 7 to 10 days each, about 357 to 510 days. f_pu is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 每次澆置前以測量確認塔柱軸線與錨箱位置，修正日照與自重造成的塔身偏移；錨箱焊縫與剪力釘做無損檢測，混凝土強度與溫度紀錄逐節保存；斜索張拉後以測力計或頻率法確認索力，與設計索力表比較。~Before each lift survey the leg axis and anchor-box positions, correcting for sun and self-weight lean; test anchor-box welds and studs non-destructively, keep strength and temperature records for every lift, and after stressing confirm stay forces by load cell or frequency methods against the design table.
units.failure: 錨箱位置誤差累積時，斜索角度偏離設計，索力與梁段高程無法同時達標；錨箱與混凝土之間的剪力傳遞不足，會在錨碇區產生劈裂裂縫，水分進入後腐蝕鋼錨箱。~Accumulated anchor-box position errors change stay angles so that stay forces and deck levels cannot both reach target; inadequate shear transfer between anchor boxes and concrete causes splitting cracks in the anchorage zone, through which water reaches and corrodes the steel boxes.
units.misconception: 混凝土橋塔只受壓，不需要擔心錨碇區的局部應力。~A concrete pylon is only in compression, so local stresses at the anchorages are no concern.
units.practice: 塔柱施工應有逐節的測量與校正程序，考慮施工時溫度與自重變形；錨箱製作、安裝與灌注各設檢驗停留點，斜索張拉完成後提交索力與塔身線形的竣工紀錄。~Pylon construction needs a lift-by-lift survey and correction procedure that accounts for temperature and self-weight deformation; anchor-box fabrication, installation and concreting each get a hold point, and as-built stay forces and pylon geometry are submitted after stressing.

units.anchor: Svanen 浮吊與整跨鋼桁~Svanen and full-span trusses
units.title: 整跨預製與浮吊安裝~Full-span prefabrication and floating-crane erection
units.mechanism: 厄勒海峽大橋約九成以大型預製件組成。引橋 49 段鋼桁梁在西班牙加的斯製造、連同混凝土橋面拖運北上，高橋 8 段鋼桁梁在瑞典卡爾斯克魯納製造，再到馬爾默加上公路橋面；自航式浮吊 Svanen 負責吊放所有梁段、沉箱與墩身。業界報導指出，Svanen 不含吊具的能力約 8,700 公噸，最重一次吊放是含鐵路設施的完整引橋段，約 7,464 公噸。整跨吊裝把海上作業縮短為定位與連接，但每次吊放都是接近設備極限的重件作業，天候窗口與動態放大必須嚴格控制。~About ninety percent of the bridge consists of large precast units. The 49 approach truss spans were built in Cádiz, Spain, and towed north with their concrete decks, while 8 high-bridge girders were built in Karlskrona, Sweden, and received their motorway deck in Malmö; the self-propelled floating crane Svanen placed all spans, caissons and pier shafts. Trade reports put Svanen's capacity at about 8,700 t without rigging, and the heaviest lift, a complete approach span with rail equipment, at about 7,464 t. Full-span lifting reduces work at sea to positioning and connection, but every lift is a heavy operation near the equipment's limit, so weather windows and dynamic amplification must be tightly controlled.
units.model: 利用率 = 7,464/8,700 ≈ 86%。若波浪造成 10% 的動態放大，等效吊重 7,464×1.1 ≈ 8,210 t，已超過含吊具的額定約 8,200 t，因此重件只能在近乎靜海的窗口吊放，使動態放大低於約 1.09。放大係數為教學假設。~Utilisation is 7,464/8,700 ≈ 86%. If waves add 10% dynamic amplification, the effective load is 7,464×1.1 ≈ 8,210 t, beyond the rating of about 8,200 t including rigging, so the heaviest lifts must wait for near-calm windows that keep amplification below about 1.09. The amplification factor is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 每次吊放前以秤重或千斤頂油壓確認實際重量與重心，並依海象預報確認浪高、風速與流速在允許範圍；吊放中監測吊索力與船體姿態，落墩時量測梁端位置與支承接觸，與設計允差比較後才鬆鉤。~Before each lift confirm actual weight and centre of gravity by weighing or jack pressures and check forecast wave height, wind and current against limits; during the lift monitor sling forces and vessel motion, and on landing measure span-end position and bearing contact against tolerances before releasing the hooks.
units.failure: 實際重量或重心與計算不符時，吊具偏載、梁段傾斜，可能撞擊墩頂或已完成的梁段；在動態放大過大的海況硬吊，吊索與吊點可能超載失效，造成重件落海的重大事故。~If actual weight or centre of gravity differs from calculation, the rigging is loaded unevenly and the span tilts, risking impact with pier heads or adjacent spans; forcing a lift in seas with excessive amplification can overload slings and lifting points and drop the span into the sea.
units.misconception: 只要浮吊額定能力大於梁段重量，就可以在任何海況下吊裝。~If the floating crane's rating exceeds the span weight, lifting is safe in any sea state.
units.practice: 重件吊裝計畫應包含秤重程序、重心計算、海象作業門檻、吊具第三方認證與中止準則，並由海事保險鑑定人或獨立工程師審查；每次吊放前召開開工會議確認所有門檻條件。~The heavy-lift plan should include weighing, centre-of-gravity calculation, metocean limits, third-party certified rigging and abort criteria, reviewed by a marine warranty surveyor or independent engineer; a pre-lift meeting confirms every limit before each lift.

units.title: 高橋主跨架設與合龍~Erecting and closing the high bridge
units.mechanism: 高橋的鋼桁梁以大型節段預製，在現場吊裝後從兩座橋塔向主跨中央逐段延伸並掛上斜索，邊跨則有中間墩支撐。每加一段鋼桁，就要依計算順序張拉對應的斜索，讓懸臂端高程與塔頂偏位維持在預測曲線上；最後在 490 公尺主跨中央接合，公開資料記載最後一段橋跨於 1999 年 8 月就位。合龍前兩端懸臂都會隨溫度與日照伸縮、上下擺動，接合需要選在溫度穩定的時段並以臨時連接器先鎖定。~The high-bridge truss was prefabricated in large sections, lifted on site and extended section by section from the two pylons toward mid-span while the stays were attached, with intermediate piers supporting the side spans. Each new truss section was followed by stressing its stays in the calculated order so that tip level and pylon-top sway stayed on the predicted curves; the halves were finally joined at the centre of the 490 m span, with the last bridge span recorded in place in August 1999. Before closure both cantilevers move with temperature and sun, so the joint must be made in a thermally stable window and locked first with temporary connectors.
units.model: 兩懸臂各長約 245 m，鋼 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C，若兩端在合龍時段內溫度變化 8 °C，合龍間隙改變 ΔL = 2×245×1.2×10⁻⁵×8 ≈ 0.047 m = 47 mm，遠大於螺栓孔或焊接坡口的容許誤差（數毫米），所以必須等溫度穩定或以千斤頂強制對位。溫差為教學假設。~Each cantilever is about 245 m long; with steel α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C, an 8 °C change during the closure window alters the gap by ΔL = 2×245×1.2×10⁻⁵×8 ≈ 0.047 m = 47 mm, far beyond the few millimetres allowed by bolt holes or weld preparations, so closure waits for stable temperature or uses jacks to force alignment. The temperature change is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 每段架設與張拉後量測懸臂端高程、塔頂偏位與代表性索力，與施工階段分析比較並更新下一步的張拉量；合龍前至少量測一個晝夜的間隙與溫度關係，鎖定後記錄連接器受力，完成連接再量測全跨線形。~After each section and stressing step, measure tip level, pylon-top sway and selected stay forces, compare with the staged analysis and update the next stressing values; before closure record gap versus temperature over at least one day–night cycle, log connector forces after locking, and survey the full span profile once connected.
units.failure: 若只依張拉力控制而不看高程，或只看高程而不看索力，兩者誤差會互相轉移，合龍時懸臂端高程差過大，需要大幅調索；強制對位時千斤頂力過大會在節點留下鎖入應力，日後在疲勞上顯現。~Controlling by force alone without levels, or levels alone without forces, shifts error from one to the other, leaving a large level difference at closure that needs major retensioning; excessive jacking to force alignment locks stresses into joints that later show up as fatigue problems.
units.misconception: 斜張橋架設時只要每根斜索拉到設計索力，線形自然就會正確。~If every stay is stressed to its design force during erection, the profile will automatically be right.
units.practice: 施工監控應同時以索力與高程雙控制，並設定兩者的允差與優先順序；合龍程序列出鎖定溫度範圍、連接順序與強制對位的最大千斤頂力，由設計單位核准後執行。~Construction control should use both stay force and level, with tolerances and a priority between them; the closure procedure lists the locking temperature range, connection sequence and maximum jack force for forced alignment, approved by the designer before execution.

units.anchor: 鐵路制動力與縱向約束~Rail braking and longitudinal restraint
units.title: 鐵路荷載、制動力與動態量測~Rail loads, braking and dynamic response
units.mechanism: 列車在橋上煞車或起動時，鋼軌把縱向力傳到橋面，再經支承與固定墩傳到基礎，所以每個連續單元都需要明確的縱向固定點。鐵路也對橋梁動態敏感：列車通過的頻率若接近橋梁的振動頻率，會出現共振放大，影響乘坐舒適與道床穩定。雙層桁架的大梁深提供高勁度，但支承、固定墩與鋼軌之間的縱向交互作用仍需專門分析，因為溫度伸縮、列車制動與鋼軌應力會互相疊加。~When trains brake or accelerate on the bridge, the rails pass longitudinal force into the deck, then through bearings and fixed piers to the foundations, so every continuous unit needs a clear longitudinal fixed point. Rail is also sensitive to dynamics: if axle passage frequencies approach a bridge frequency, resonance amplifies response, affecting comfort and track stability. The deep double-deck truss gives high stiffness, but longitudinal interaction between bearings, fixed piers and rails still needs dedicated analysis because thermal movement, braking and rail stresses add together.
units.model: 依 EN 1991-2 的特徵值，制動力 Q_lbk = 20 kN/m × 載重長度（上限 6,000 kN），起動力 Q_lak = 33 kN/m × 載重長度（上限 1,000 kN）。一個 140 m 引橋跨：制動力 20×140 = 2,800 kN，起動力 33×140 = 4,620 kN 但取上限 1,000 kN。固定墩須承擔 2,800 kN 的縱向力加溫度與摩擦力。~Using EN 1991-2 characteristic values, braking Q_lbk = 20 kN/m times loaded length (capped at 6,000 kN) and traction Q_lak = 33 kN/m times loaded length (capped at 1,000 kN). On one 140 m approach span, braking is 20×140 = 2,800 kN, and traction 33×140 = 4,620 kN is capped at 1,000 kN. The fixed pier must take the 2,800 kN plus thermal and friction forces.
units.verify: 完工前以實際列車在不同速度下通過，量測橋面加速度、跨中撓度、支承縱向位移與鋼軌應力，並與動態分析比較；鐵路主管機關依量測確認橋面加速度與鋼軌附加應力在限值內後，才開放營運速度。~Before opening, run trains at several speeds while measuring deck acceleration, mid-span deflection, longitudinal bearing movement and rail stresses, comparing them with dynamic analysis; the railway authority releases operating speeds only after confirming deck accelerations and additional rail stresses are within limits.
units.failure: 固定墩或縱向約束不足時，列車制動使梁體縱向滑移，支承與伸縮裝置受損；若忽略鋼軌與橋梁的交互作用，夏季高溫加上制動可能使鋼軌附加壓應力過大，增加軌道挫屈風險。~With an inadequate fixed pier or restraint, braking slides the deck longitudinally and damages bearings and expansion devices; ignoring rail–bridge interaction can let summer heat plus braking raise additional compressive rail stress enough to increase track-buckling risk.
units.misconception: 鐵路的制動力很小，與橋梁自重相比可以忽略。~Rail braking forces are tiny compared with self-weight and can be ignored.
units.practice: 鐵路橋設計應由結構與軌道工程師共同完成縱向交互作用分析，明訂固定墩位置、支承摩擦假設與鋼軌伸縮調節器位置；營運前的列車試驗計畫須經鐵路主管機關核准並列為開放營運的停留點。~Rail bridges need a joint structural–track analysis of longitudinal interaction that fixes the fixed piers, bearing friction assumptions and rail expansion device locations; the pre-opening train test plan is approved by the railway authority and is a hold point before operation.

units.title: 船舶撞擊風險與防撞島~Ship-impact risk and protective islands
units.mechanism: 厄勒海峽是繁忙航道，公開資料指出德羅格登航道每年約 4 萬艘船通過，高橋下方的弗林特航道約佔一成。橋墩與橋塔若被大型船舶撞擊，可能造成倒塌與人命傷亡，因此設計者在橋塔與鄰近橋墩周圍設置人工島，使偏航船舶先擱淺或被導開，而不是直接撞上結構。船撞設計通常以風險法進行：估計每年經過的船數、偏航機率、撞到特定構造物的幾何機率與撞擊後倒塌機率，乘積須低於可接受的年頻率。~The Øresund is a busy waterway: published data cite about 40,000 ships a year through the Drogden channel, with the Flinte channel under the high bridge carrying about a tenth. A large ship striking a pier or pylon could cause collapse and loss of life, so designers placed artificial islands around the pylons and nearby piers so that an errant ship grounds or is deflected before reaching the structure. Ship-impact design usually follows a risk method: estimate annual vessel passages, the probability of aberrancy, the geometric probability of hitting a given element and the probability of collapse given a hit, whose product must fall below an acceptable annual frequency.
units.model: 年倒塌頻率 AF = N·PA·PG·PC。取 N = 4,000 艘/年、PA = 1×10⁻⁴、PG = 0.05、PC = 0.1：AF = 4,000×10⁻⁴×0.05×0.1 = 2.0×10⁻³ /年，遠高於常用的 1×10⁻⁴；人工島使船舶到達結構的幾何機率降到 PG = 0.002 時，AF = 8×10⁻⁵ /年。機率值為教學假設。~Annual collapse frequency AF = N·PA·PG·PC. With N = 4,000 ships a year, PA = 1×10⁻⁴, PG = 0.05 and PC = 0.1, AF = 4,000×10⁻⁴×0.05×0.1 = 2.0×10⁻³ per year, far above the commonly used 1×10⁻⁴; islands that cut the geometric probability to PG = 0.002 give AF = 8×10⁻⁵ per year. Probabilities are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以航道交通調查、船型分布與航跡資料建立風險模型，對每座墩與塔計算撞擊能量與年頻率；人工島與護岸以船舶擱淺模擬或船撞數值分析檢核其吸能與阻擋效果，並把結果與業主訂定的風險準則逐項比較。~Build the risk model from vessel traffic surveys, fleet distributions and track data, computing impact energy and annual frequency for every pier and pylon; check the islands and revetments by grounding simulations or ship-collision analyses for energy absorption and stopping effect, comparing results item by item with the owner's risk criteria.
units.failure: 若只以單一設計船舶的撞擊力設計橋墩而不做風險分析，可能在交通量最高或最脆弱的位置留下風險缺口；航道船型日後變大而未重新評估，原本足夠的防護可能不再有效。~Designing piers for one design vessel's impact force without risk analysis can leave a gap at the busiest or most vulnerable positions; if the fleet grows larger without reassessment, protection that was once adequate may no longer suffice.
units.misconception: 只要橋墩夠粗壯，就能承受任何船舶撞擊，不需要額外防護。~A sufficiently massive pier can withstand any ship impact without extra protection.
units.practice: 業主應在設計基準中訂定可接受的年倒塌頻率與設計船舶，並要求營運期定期更新航道交通資料重新評估；防撞島、導航燈與船舶交通管理系統屬於同一套防護體系，任何一項變更都要重新檢核整體風險。~The owner should fix the acceptable annual collapse frequency and design vessels in the design basis and require periodic reassessment with updated traffic data; protective islands, navigation lights and vessel traffic management form one protection system, so changing any of them requires a fresh overall risk check.

units.anchor: 鐵路縱梁疲勞細節~Rail stringer fatigue details
units.title: 鐵路循環下的疲勞與防蝕~Fatigue and corrosion under rail cycles
units.mechanism: 鐵路荷載重複性高、軸重大，每列車通過都在縱梁、橫梁與桁架節點產生多次應力循環，因此鋼桁的設計壽命常由疲勞而不是強度控制。焊接細節的類別決定可承受的應力幅：橫向角焊、加勁板端部與開孔處是常見的弱點。海峽環境的鹽霧又會讓塗裝劣化、在節點縫隙形成腐蝕，腐蝕坑會成為新的疲勞起點。斜索則以鍍鋅、塗蠟與塑膠套管多層防護，重點在於讓水無法積在錨頭與套管接頭。~Rail loading is highly repetitive with heavy axles, and every train produces several stress cycles in stringers, cross-girders and truss joints, so the life of a steel truss is often governed by fatigue rather than strength. The detail category sets the tolerable stress range, with transverse fillet welds, stiffener ends and cut-outs as common weak points. Salt spray in the strait degrades coatings and drives crevice corrosion at joints, and corrosion pits become new fatigue initiation sites. Stays rely on layered protection of galvanising, wax and plastic sheathing, the key being that water cannot collect at anchor heads or sheath joints.
units.model: EN 1993-1-9：細節類別 Δσ_C = 71 MPa，等幅疲勞限 Δσ_D = 0.737×71 ≈ 52.3 MPa（5×10⁶ 次）。若 100 年內有 200 列車/日 × 365 × 100 = 7.3×10⁶ 次主要循環，m = 5 段延伸得 Δσ ≈ 52.3×(5×10⁶/7.3×10⁶)^(1/5) ≈ 48.5 MPa。交通量與單一循環假設為教學假設。~EN 1993-1-9: for detail category Δσ_C = 71 MPa the constant-amplitude limit is Δσ_D = 0.737×71 ≈ 52.3 MPa at 5×10⁶ cycles. With 200 trains a day × 365 × 100 = 7.3×10⁶ main cycles in 100 years, extending with slope m = 5 gives Δσ ≈ 52.3×(5×10⁶/7.3×10⁶)^(1/5) ≈ 48.5 MPa. Traffic and one-cycle-per-train are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以應變計量測列車通過時代表性細節的應力歷時，用雨流計數求等效應力幅並與設計值比較；定期檢查節點、焊趾與塗裝，以磁粒或超音波檢測可疑裂紋，並量測塗膜厚度與鏽蝕等級建立劣化趨勢。~Strain-gauge representative details under train passages, derive equivalent stress ranges by rainflow counting and compare with design; inspect joints, weld toes and coatings regularly, test suspect cracks by magnetic particle or ultrasonics, and measure coating thickness and rust grade to build deterioration trends.
units.failure: 疲勞裂紋若出現在縱梁與橫梁連接處而未被發現，裂紋擴展可能導致縱梁失去支撐、軌道沉陷；塗裝失效處的腐蝕坑讓疲勞強度再降一級，原本足夠的壽命大幅縮短。~An undetected fatigue crack at a stringer-to-cross-girder connection can grow until the stringer loses support and the track settles; corrosion pits where coating has failed lower fatigue strength by another category, sharply shortening a life that was once adequate.
units.misconception: 鋼橋只要塗裝完好，就不會有疲勞問題。~A steel bridge with intact paint cannot have fatigue problems.
units.practice: 檢查計畫應依疲勞細節類別與實測應力幅排定優先順序，最敏感的細節縮短檢查週期；塗裝維修與疲勞檢查同時規劃，噴砂後先做裂紋檢測再重新塗裝，避免把裂紋封在漆膜下。~The inspection plan should prioritise details by category and measured stress range, shortening intervals for the most sensitive; schedule repainting together with fatigue inspection, testing for cracks after blasting and before recoating so cracks are not sealed under paint.

units.anchor: 鋼軌伸縮調節器~Rail expansion devices
units.title: 鋼軌伸縮調節器與營運交接~Rail expansion devices and handover
units.mechanism: 長焊鋼軌只能吸收有限的橋梁伸縮，當連續單元太長、梁端伸縮量超過鋼軌與道床可承受的範圍，就必須在梁端設置鋼軌伸縮調節器，讓兩段鋼軌相對滑動。斜張高橋長 1,092 公尺，加上溫度、列車制動與潛變的影響，梁端的縱向位移遠大於一般短跨。交接時營運單位需要完整的伸縮紀錄：各單元的固定點、伸縮縫與調節器的設計行程、竣工時的設定值與溫度，以及檢查與更換程序，才能判斷日後的位移是否正常。~Continuous welded rail can absorb only limited bridge movement; when a continuous unit is so long that end movement exceeds what rail and ballast can take, rail expansion devices are needed at the deck ends so the two rails can slide relative to each other. The cable-stayed high bridge is 1,092 m long, and with temperature, braking and creep its end movements are far larger than for short spans. At handover the operator needs complete movement records: fixed points of each unit, design travel of joints and rail devices, set values and temperatures at completion, and inspection and replacement procedures, to judge whether later movements are normal.
units.model: 高橋長 1,092 m，若以中央為不動點，梁端受影響長度 546 m；鋼 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C、溫差 40 °C：ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×546×40 ≈ 0.262 m = 262 mm，遠超過長焊鋼軌在無調節器下通常可容許的梁端伸縮，因此需設鋼軌伸縮調節器。固定點與溫差為教學假設。~The high bridge is 1,092 m long; fixed at the centre, each end is driven by 546 m. With α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C and a 40 °C range, ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×546×40 ≈ 0.262 m = 262 mm, far beyond the end movement continuous welded rail can usually accept without a device, so rail expansion devices are needed. Fixed point and range are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 竣工時記錄調節器尖軌位置、伸縮縫開口與梁溫；營運中按季節量測並繪出位移與溫度關係，斜率偏離或出現殘餘漂移即檢查支承與固定墩；鐵路單位同步量測軌距、軌向與鋼軌溫度，確認調節器滑動順暢。~At completion record switch-blade positions of the rail devices, joint openings and deck temperature; in service measure seasonally and plot movement against temperature, inspecting bearings and fixed piers if the slope departs or drift appears; the railway operator measures gauge, alignment and rail temperature at the same time to confirm the devices slide freely.
units.failure: 調節器卡滯或設定位置錯誤時，夏季高溫可能使尖軌頂死、鋼軌承受過大壓力，冬季則開口過大影響行車；若伸縮紀錄在交接時遺失，管理單位無法分辨正常溫度位移與支承或基礎異常。~A seized or mis-set rail device can jam in summer heat and overstress the rails, or open too far in winter and affect running; if movement records are lost at handover, the operator cannot tell normal thermal movement from bearing or foundation problems.
units.misconception: 長焊鋼軌可以吸收任何長度橋梁的溫度伸縮。~Continuous welded rail can absorb the thermal movement of a bridge of any length.
units.practice: 交接文件應整合公路與鐵路兩套資料：伸縮縫與調節器的型號、行程、設定溫度、更換程序與封閉時段，以及斜索索力、橋塔線形與船撞防護的基準；並約定公路與鐵路營運單位之間的通報與聯合檢查機制。~Handover should merge road and rail documentation: types, travel, set temperatures, replacement procedures and possession windows for joints and rail devices, plus baselines for stay forces, pylon geometry and ship-impact protection, and agree a notification and joint-inspection protocol between road and rail operators.

example: 豎琴式斜索設計練習：塔上錨距 12 m、梁上錨距 20 m，索角 θ = arctan(12/20) ≈ 31.0°，sinθ ≈ 0.514。若每個索面在每公尺承受 w = 200 kN/m，每根索支撐 20 m，索力 T = 200×20/0.514 ≈ 7,775 kN。單股 7 根 5 mm 鋼線面積約 137.4 mm²、f_pu = 1,860 MPa，以 0.45 f_pu = 837 MPa 設計，需要 7,775,000/(837×137.4) ≈ 67.6，取 68 股，實際應力約 832 MPa。若 w 增加到 215 kN/m，T ≈ 8,358 kN，需約 72.7，取 73 股。活載使索力增加 15%（約 1,166 kN）時，200 m 長、68 股的索彈性伸長 ΔL = ΔT·L/(E·A) = 1,166,000×200/(195,000×9,346) ≈ 0.128 m，這是橋面撓度的一部分。數值為教學假設，不代表厄勒海峽大橋的設計。~Harp-stay exercise: with anchor spacings of 12 m on the pylon and 20 m on the girder, θ = arctan(12/20) ≈ 31.0° and sinθ ≈ 0.514. If each cable plane carries w = 200 kN/m and each stay supports 20 m, T = 200×20/0.514 ≈ 7,775 kN. One strand of seven 5 mm wires has about 137.4 mm²; with f_pu = 1,860 MPa and design at 0.45 f_pu = 837 MPa, 7,775,000/(837×137.4) ≈ 67.6, so 68 strands at an actual stress of about 832 MPa. If w rises to 215 kN/m, T ≈ 8,358 kN and about 72.7, so 73 strands, are needed. When live load raises the force by 15% (about 1,166 kN), a 200 m, 68-strand stay stretches ΔL = ΔT·L/(E·A) = 1,166,000×200/(195,000×9,346) ≈ 0.128 m elastically, part of the deck deflection. Values are teaching assumptions, not the Øresund design.
history: 丹麥與瑞典在 1991 年簽署興建厄勒海峽固定通道的協定，採用人工島、沉管隧道與橋梁的組合，以避免阻擋哥本哈根機場附近的空域與航道，並滿足對波羅的海水流的零阻水要求。橋梁由 Arup 領導的 ASO 設計團隊在設計競圖中勝出，以設計—施工合約由 Sundlink 聯合承攬，大量採用陸上預製與浮吊整跨吊裝；1995 年海上工程展開，1999 年 8 月最後一段橋跨就位，2000 年 7 月 1 日通車，提前且未超出預算。其工程新意在於主跨 490 公尺的公路鐵路雙層斜張橋、以設計修整與補償浚挖達成零阻水，以及接近設備極限的整跨吊裝。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何設計文件。~Denmark and Sweden agreed in 1991 to build a fixed link across the Øresund, combining an artificial island, an immersed tunnel and a bridge so as to keep airspace near Copenhagen Airport and the shipping lanes clear and to meet a zero-blocking requirement for Baltic water exchange. The bridge design by the Arup-led ASO group won the design competition and was built under a design-and-construct contract by the Sundlink consortium, relying heavily on onshore prefabrication and full-span floating-crane lifts; marine works started in 1995, the last bridge span was placed in August 1999 and the link opened on 1 July 2000, ahead of schedule and within budget. Its novelties were a double-deck road–rail cable-stayed bridge with a 490 m span, zero blocking achieved by design trimming plus compensation dredging, and full-span lifts near equipment limits. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any design documents.
facts: 橋梁全長約 7,845 公尺，斜張高橋長約 1,092 公尺~The bridge is about 7,845 m long, with a cable-stayed high bridge about 1,092 m long
主跨 490 公尺，邊跨 160 與 141 公尺，航道淨高約 57 公尺~Main span 490 m with side spans of 160 m and 141 m and navigation clearance of about 57 m
兩座混凝土橋塔高約 204 公尺，每支塔柱約 4,335 立方公尺混凝土與 800 公噸鋼筋~The two concrete pylons are about 204 m tall, each leg using about 4,335 m³ of concrete and 800 t of reinforcement
160 根豎琴式斜索，每根 68 至 73 股、每股 7 根 5 mm 鋼線，斜索總重約 2,150 公噸~160 harp-pattern stays of 68 to 73 strands of seven 5 mm wires, about 2,150 t of cable in total
西引橋約 3,014 公尺、東引橋約 3,739 公尺，主要跨徑 140 公尺~The west approach is about 3,014 m and the east about 3,739 m long, with typical 140 m spans
浮吊 Svanen 不含吊具約 8,700 公噸，最重吊放約 7,464 公噸~The floating crane Svanen lifts about 8,700 t without rigging, and the heaviest lift was about 7,464 t
設計修整把計算阻水率由約 2.3% 降到約 0.5%，其餘以補償浚挖抵銷~Design trimming cut calculated blocking from about 2.3% to about 0.5%, with compensation dredging offsetting the rest
橋塔與邊跨墩沉箱坐落在海平面下約 14 至 17 公尺的石灰岩上~Pylon and side-span caissons sit on limestone about 14 to 17 m below sea level
公路與鐵路於 2000 年 7 月 1 日開放通行~Road and rail traffic opened on 1 July 2000
